lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular white spots arranged in vertical columns along the lateral flank. The spots are evenly distributed with approximately 4-5 spots per vertical column in the mid-body section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the horizontal carinae, with circular blobs centered at many of these intersection points, creating a rectilinear grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp luminance transition with lighter pixels on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowed pixels on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs of varying sizes, primarily distributed in the lower and middle regions of the fin's surface silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal white linear scar or abrasion is visible on the flank just posterior to the base of the first dorsal fin, intersecting the regular spot pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tip of the visible pectoral fin displays a concentrated, high-luminance white pigmentation mark at the trailing edge.
